material_findings.title: Queued open callback does not recheck saved-source freshness
material_findings.code_path: act(open_export) background inspect() calls flow.inspect_path(), including the fresh export CLI reader, then job.check_live(), then wx.CallAfter(self.opened,...). Window.opened() checks only cancel_requested/closing before subprocess.Popen or webbrowser.open. It never calls flow.fresh() at UI delivery time.
material_findings.concrete_counterexample: Let the background export reader and inspect_path finish successfully, hold the queued wx.CallAfter callback, and change one byte of the saved source project. Then deliver opened('export',target,None) with cancel_requested=false and closing=false. Its current source path deterministically launches /usr/bin/open and retains ready state without examining the changed source. The same queued gap exists for review/preview targets. This is source-derived; no live GUI reproduction was performed in this read-only task.
material_findings.impact: Open checked export can launch after the source has become stale during the queue interval, despite the saved-source freshness precondition enforced earlier by inspect_path. This does not demonstrate routing acceptance or Native proof forgery.
material_findings.smallest_regression_and_fix_scope: Use the existing extracted Window.opened test helper with a real or mocked flow whose fresh() raises the saved-source-changed error at callback delivery, a noncancelled job, and a mocked opener. Assert no opener call, refusal text and cleared positive state. Recheck flow/source/settings ownership freshness in opened immediately before launch, with cancellation precedence and refusal behavior preserved. Do not run a central Native reader on the UI thread or claim that this eliminates all filesystem races.

nearby_checks_and_test_names: CliJob serializes startup/cancel, refuses cancelled adoption before and after flow.adopt, joins its watchdog, reaps the child and closes stdout in finally.

Workflow.command requires completed stages and explicit accept intent before fresh export. Workflow.inspect_path(export) requires a new cancellable CLI reader, exact current candidate/project identity, target containment and fresh source/settings before returning.

tests/test_gui_budget_refusal.py: test_cancelled_inspection_does_not_open_or_retain_positive_ui; test_failed_opener_clears_positive_ui_and_shows_retained_reason. These do not cover a source mutation after worker return and before opened callback delivery.
scope: One bounded source finding in the requested cancellation/review-choice/export/open paths only. No source edits, imports, tests, processes, Native/JVM, network, qualification repeat or recursive delegation.
